part_name: DZT5551 (high-voltage NPN transistor, SOT-223) - the 2N5551 / MMBT5551 die in a package that dissipates more

why_this_part: ADR-068 (L56): the VAS load current sink (Q125) moves from MMBT5551 in SOT-23 (417 C/W) to the same die in SOT-223. After ADR-067, with a short at an output (P7, ADR-021), it dissipates 0.191 W: 140 C at 60 C air in SOT-23 against the 125 C limit, 84 C in SOT-223.

thermal.R_thJA_datasheet: 62.5 C/W, P_D 2 W, note 5: 50 x 50 mm of 1 oz copper, still air. R_thJL 45 C/W, R_thJC 27 C/W. The datasheet gives NO minimum-pad figure.
thermal.R_thJA_the_design_uses: 125 C/W - the DZT5401's minimum-recommended-pad figure (DS31218, note 5), SAME SOT-223 PACKAGE. A DECLARED ASSUMPTION, not a datasheet figure for this part. The tab is the collector, NY, a signal node: no large copper there.
